title: Rate limiter rewrite
headline: The token bucket now refills from a monotonic clock, and the distributed path is unchanged.
synthesis:
## What changed

The token bucket now refills from a monotonic clock, so a wall-clock adjustment can no longer hand a caller a full bucket. The burst ceiling moved into configuration; `limiter.New` reads it once at construction rather than per request.

## What is not covered

The distributed path still shares one Redis key per tenant. Nothing here changes that, and the contention it causes under fan-out is unmeasured.
limits: The distributed path still shares one Redis key per tenant; its contention under fan-out is unmeasured.
